# ArenaX-Web: Public Views, Component Map & Content Preservation Catalog

**Generated by**: Teamwork Explorer (`explorer_survey_2`)  
**Timestamp**: 2026-11-07T06:25:00Z  
**Project**: ArenaX-Web (`c:\Users\Muhammad Minhas\ArenaX-Web`)  
**Mission**: Catalog all public-facing pages, views, sections, UI components, text content, and visual redesign requirements for strict adherence to Supabase design tokens (Requirement R2) while preserving 100% of existing content (Requirement R3).

---

## 1. Executive Architecture Summary

ArenaX-Web is a high-performance single-page application built with:
- **Framework**: React 18.3.1 with TypeScript 5.5.3 + Vite 8.3.5
- **Routing**: `react-router-dom` v7.18.5 with client-side history routing
- **Smooth Scrolling & Animation**: Lenis 1.3.16 + GSAP 3.15.0 (ScrollTrigger plugin)
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS 3.4.1 + CSS custom variables + PostCSS / Autoprefixer
- **Icons**: `lucide-react` 0.344.0 (1.5 stroke width)
- **Typography**: Inter (Body), Manrope / Outfit (Headings), Source Code Pro / JetBrains Mono (Monospace / Tabular Telemetry)
- **Analytics**: `react-ga4` with custom event logging and page view tracking
- **Test Invariant Suites**: Node.js native test runner (`node --test`), 13 test files spanning 5 tiers of functional, boundary, layout-copy, and challenger invariants. Current baseline status: **100% PASSING**.

## 2. Public-Facing Routes & View Registry

All routes are declared in `src/App.tsx` and wrapped within global chrome (`Navbar`, `SmoothScroll`, `Footer`, `WhatsAppButton`):

| Route Path | View / Component | Page Type | Section Anchor ID(s) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `/` | `HomePage` | Single-Page Showcase | `#home`, `#statement`, `#app-showcase`, `#tournaments`, `#ai-vision`, `#wallet`, `#ranks`, `#organizers`, `#how-it-works`, `#comparison`, `#scout-rewards`, `#download` | Main landing experience featuring 10 sequential showcase sections + Hero + Statement |
| `/about` | `About` | Standalone Page | N/A | Mission, platform origin story, 4 core values, APK download CTA |
| `/faq` | `FAQ` | Standalone Page | N/A | 10-item expandable accordion knowledge base, 24/7 helpdesk contact box |
| `/contact` | `Contact` | Standalone Page | N/A | Support channels (Email, WhatsApp, 24/7 availability) and interactive ticket dispatch form |
| `/terms` | `Terms` | Standalone Page | N/A | Official terms of service, player eligibility, account security, skill classification |
| `/privacy` | `Privacy` | Standalone Page | N/A | Privacy policy, data collection, Free Fire UID processing, data retention |
| `/refund-policy` | `RefundPolicy` | Standalone Page | N/A | 100% automated cancellation refund policy, room disruptions, voluntary withdrawal rules |
| `/fair-play` | `FairPlay` | Standalone Page | N/A | Mobile-only rules, anti-emulator policy, AI tamper detection, lifetime hardware bans |
| `*` | `HomePage` | Wildcard Fallback | N/A | Redirects any unknown route back to HomePage with scroll restoration |

### 5.1 Supabase Design Tokens vs Current ArenaX Implementation

|---|---|---|---|
| **Primary Brand Green** | Signature Supabase Emerald `#3ECF8E` (`--brand-default`, `--brand-500`, `oklch(69.6% .17 162.48)`). Hover stop `#34B27B` (`--brand-600`), darker tone `#249361` (`--brand-400`). | Present in `--accent` (`#3ECF8E`), `--accent-hover` (`#34B27B`), `--brand-default`. Used across buttons, active borders, and progress indicators. | **Preserve & Strictify**: Ensure all primary actions use exact `#3ECF8E` with `oklch` / hex precision. Remove any leftover non-standard green shades. |
| **Dark Carbon Surfaces** | Hierarchy of dark carbon surfaces:<br>- Base/canvas: `#121212` / `oklch(20.5% 0 0)`<br>- Deepest/footer: `#0E0F0E` / `#0A0A0A`<br>- Cards/panels: `#171717` / `#181818` (`surface-100`)<br>- Raised/popover: `#202220` / `#242424` (`surface-200`) | `--bg-0: #0E0F0E`, `--bg-1: #121212`, `--bg-2: #171817`, `--bg-3: #202220` in `src/index.css`. | **Refine**: Ensure card backgrounds have uniform dark carbon depth without heavy gaming gradients. Replace gaming gradients with Supabase's subtle linear card sheen (`linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.035) 0%, transparent 42%)`). |
| **Borders & Hairlines** | Ultra-fine, subtle hairline borders:<br>`1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)` (`--border`)<br>`rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14)` (`--border-control-hover`)<br>`rgba(62, 207, 142, 0.35)` (`--border-brand`) | Present in `--line: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)`, `--line-strong: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14)`. | **Clean Up**: Eliminate heavy gaming bracket corners (`HudCorners`) where not strictly necessary, or style them as understated luxury hairline accents that match Supabase's architectural cards. |
| **Typography Hierarchy** | - Headings: `Manrope` (or system sans fallbacks `Inter`, `-apple-system`) with tight tracking (`-0.025em` to `-0.05em`) and font weights 700/800.<br>- Body: `Inter` (weights 400, 450, 500, 600).<br>- Monospace: `Source Code Pro` / `JetBrains Mono` for tabular metrics, code blocks, and data badges. | Font configuration already loads Google Fonts for Inter, Manrope, Source Code Pro. | **Align**: Ensure strict typographic rhythm across headings (`text-balance`, clean letter-spacing, zero clutter), crisp monospace tags, and body text line-height (`1.5` to `1.625`). |

| **Component Styling: Cards** | Clean rectangular surfaces, 12px–16px border-radius, hairline border, inset top highlight (`inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.05)`), soft dark drop shadow (`0 20px 48px -20px rgba(0,0,0,0.75)`). | Currently `.hud-card` and `.hud-card-highlight`. | **Polish**: Make sure `.hud-card` and `.hud-card-highlight` adhere strictly to Supabase card surface depth and subtle emerald edge glow on hover. |
| **Component Styling: Badges & Tabs** | Segmented tab bars with dark carbon background (`#171717`), 1px border, active pill with `#3ECF8E` fill or emerald border accent. Badges with font-mono, tabular numerals, 11px uppercase. | Already implemented across `TournamentModes`, `AIVisionShowcase`, `AppExperienceShowcase`. | **Preserve**: Keep tab state and badge tokens cleanly mapped to Supabase tokens. |

### 5.2 Critical Invariants to Respect During Redesign
1. **Never alter reference HTML/files**: `Supabase _ The Postgres Development Platform.html` and `Supabase _ The Postgres Development Platform_files` MUST NOT be modified under any circumstances.
2. **Never break existing tests**: The 13 test suites in `tests/` check specific strings (e.g., `Download App`, `ArenaX`, `Bermuda BR`, `Clash Squad 4v4`, `20 PTS Booyah`, `5 PTS Kill`, `1 AX = 1 PKR`, `arenasupport@gmail.com`, `+923367135319`, `com.arenax.app`, etc.).
3. **No subtext prop on `<Stat />`**: The test suite strictly prohibits passing `subtext` to `<Stat />`.
4. **Mobile menu body overflow**: Must clear `document.body.style.overflow = ''` when closing the mobile menu.
5. **No marketing essay clutter**: Keep copy clean and direct, preserving all verified factual copy without re-introducing deprecated marketing taglines.

## 6. Verification Plan & Test Commands

To verify that any redesign maintains complete integrity:

1. **TypeScript Typecheck**:
   ```powershell
   npm run typecheck
   ```
   *Expected: Zero type errors across all ts/tsx files.*

2. **ESLint Code Analysis**:
   ```powershell
   npm run lint
   ```
   *Expected: Zero lint warnings or errors.*

3. **Production Build**:
   ```powershell
   npm run build
   ```
   *Expected: Clean Vite production bundle in `dist/`.*

4. **Complete Unified Verification Suite**:
   ```powershell
   npm test
   ```
   *Expected: 100% of tests passing across all 13 test files (Tiers 1–5, layout-copy verification, and challenger suites).*
